newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial Realty buys more properties.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial Realty buys more properties.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Monday it made three investments totalling $31.1 million for involving 1.1 million square feet.
The transactions include the 23-building Airport Park industrial complex in Detroit, five properties in Indianapolis and two properties in Atlanta, said First Industrial Realty.
So far this year, the company has invested a total of $236 million for 100 industrial properties to increase its portfolio by 42 percent.
First Industrial Realty Trust owns, buys and manages warehouse and industrial properties.
The company's stock rose 3/8 Monday to close at 29.
